name: NYSAVE (NY Save Animals in Veterinary Emergency)
region_note: HELP PAYING VET BILLS (financial aid - prevents economic euthanasia; apply to several at once, funds go to the vet)
notes:
NYC-SPECIFIC emergency funding for sick/injured pets of low-income NYC residents (all 5 boroughs). At/below NYC poverty level (about $41,100 for 1 person / $58,700 for a family of 4); must first be denied by CareCredit/Scratchpay; ~$2,000/yr per household, paid to a participating vet. (917) 669-7281 - info@nysave.org - nysave.org.
